class TokenBucket:
    """A token bucket rate limiter with an injectable clock."""

    def __init__(self, rate, capacity, clock):
        if isinstance(rate, bool) or not isinstance(rate, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("rate must be a number > 0, got %r" % (rate,))
        if rate <= 0:
            raise ValueError("rate must be a number > 0, got %r" % (rate,))
        if isinstance(capacity, bool) or not isinstance(capacity, int):
            raise ValueError("capacity must be an int >= 1, got %r" % (capacity,))
        if capacity < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be an int >= 1, got %r" % (capacity,))
        if not callable(clock):
            raise TypeError("clock must be callable, got %r" % (clock,))

        self.rate = rate
        self.capacity = capacity
        self._clock = clock
        self._balance = 0.0  # the bucket starts empty
        self._ref = float(clock())  # reference time, taken at construction

    def _refill(self):
        """Accrue ``elapsed * rate`` tokens since the reference time.

        Accrual is capped at ``capacity`` (excess is discarded) and the
        reference time advances to now. A backward-moving clock accrues
        nothing and never moves the reference time back.
        """
        now = float(self._clock())
        if now > self._ref:
            elapsed = now - self._ref
            self._balance = min(self.capacity, self._balance + elapsed * self.rate)
            self._ref = now

    def take(self, n=1):
        """Grant ``n`` tokens if available; otherwise consume nothing."""
        if isinstance(n, bool) or not isinstance(n, int):
            raise ValueError("n must be an int >= 1, got %r" % (n,))
        if n < 1:
            raise ValueError("n must be an int >= 1, got %r" % (n,))

        self._refill()
        if self._balance >= n:  # boundary inclusive: an exactly-completed token grants
            self._balance -= n
            return True
        return False

    def tokens(self):
        """The currently available amount, after applying the refill rule."""
        self._refill()
        return float(self._balance)
